hero.badge: Public Cardity Core API is live
hero.title: Cardity Core
hero.subtitle: Turn protocol intent into system-ready artifacts for agents.
hero.description: Cardity Core compiles Cardity protocol source into ABI, protocol JSON, and Agent OS manifests. Agents can call the public API or MCP endpoint to generate the contract surface of a complete app from a precise protocol.

pipeline.title: From one protocol to a buildable system
pipeline.subtitle: Cardity is the deterministic layer between natural-language agents and production code generation.

steps.title: Describe intent
steps.description: An agent or developer starts with a business rule, workflow, or protocol idea.

steps.title: Compile protocol
steps.description: Cardity Core validates the source and emits a stable machine-readable protocol contract.

steps.title: Generate system plan
steps.description: The Agent OS manifest exposes actions, state, permissions, API routes, UI resources, and workflows.

steps.title: Build with agents
steps.description: Downstream agents can generate services, UI, tests, and runtime integrations from the same source of truth.

artifacts.title: Artifacts agents can trust
artifacts.subtitle: The public API is compiler-only: it accepts source text and returns structured artifacts without signing, deploying, or reading a user's workspace.

items.title: ABI
items.description: Typed method definitions, parameters, return values, and callable protocol shape.

items.title: Protocol JSON
items.description: A normalized representation of protocol state, methods, events, and metadata.

items.title: Agent OS manifest
items.description: Action schemas, permissions, API route hints, UI resources, database state, and workflow triggers.

integrations.title: Designed for every agent surface
integrations.subtitle: Use Cardity Core remotely today, or keep it local when a desktop agent needs filesystem-level control.

items.title: Public API
items.description: Call https://api.cardity.org from any agent, workflow, or backend service.

items.title: MCP endpoint
items.description: Discover and invoke cardity_compile through the hosted JSON-RPC MCP endpoint.

items.title: CLI and local MCP
items.description: Run the same compiler locally for private workspaces, CI, and deeper Agent OS integrations.

cta.title: Give agents a protocol before they write code
cta.subtitle: A precise protocol contract lets agents generate systems with clearer permissions, routes, state, and workflows.
